label: Attorney engagement letter – Patricia Nguyen
subject: Engagement Confirmation – Nguyen & Associates Legal Group
body:
Dear Ms. Johnson,

Thank you for choosing Nguyen & Associates Legal Group to represent you. We are pleased to confirm our engagement to assist you with your business contract matter.

Your primary attorney will be Patricia Nguyen, Esq., who leads our Business and Contract Law division. Ms. Nguyen has over fifteen years of experience in contract law and commercial litigation, and has successfully represented clients in a wide range of business disputes and transactional matters.

To reach Ms. Nguyen directly:
Email: pnguyen@nguyenlaw.com
Phone: (415) 555-0188
Direct Line: (415) 555-0189

Our office is located at 580 California Street, Suite 1200, San Francisco, CA 94104. Office hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Please review the attached engagement agreement at your earliest convenience. It outlines our fee structure, billing practices, scope of representation, and your rights as a client. Once we receive your signed agreement and retainer payment of $2,500, we will begin our analysis of your matter immediately.

We look forward to working with you.

Sincerely,
Patricia Nguyen, Esq.
Nguyen & Associates Legal Group
pnguyen@nguyenlaw.com
(415) 555-0188
